peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (40.5): 2.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 155 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 8). Context, not scored: resales in 29.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from Dec 2022 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 2 earlier resales do not start the wave.

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Haw Par Villa MRT about 1,590 m, Kent Ridge MRT about 1,630 m; closer than 2 of 662 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 0 within 2 km; nearest Fairfield Methodist School (Primary) about 2,020 m; more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 125). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 0 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 1,210 m), more than 0 of 662 similar developments (the same as 54); nearest hawker centre Clementi West Street 2 Blk 726 about 1,580 m; nearest park West Coast Park about 300 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Hillshore, 6 new sales, about 1,230 m; Elta, 81 new sales, about 1,880 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 38 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 87 new sales and 167 resales (254 purchases); new sales were 34.3% of these purchases. Subsales (5) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dover Drive GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,840 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 167 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 2 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 167 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 187 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−10.7%). Planning-area private resales −1.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
